title: kserve values
description: Schema for kserve Helm chart values.

global.description: Compatibility values inherited from umbrella charts. Accepted but ignored by this chart.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in generated labels.

commonLabels.description: Labels merged into every rendered resource.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations merged into every rendered resource.

apiVersions.description: Default API version overrides per supported KServe kind.

clusterServingRuntimes.description: Map of ClusterServingRuntime resources keyed by resource name.

clusterStorageContainers.description: Map of ClusterStorageContainer resources keyed by resource name.

inferenceGraphs.description: Map of InferenceGraph resources keyed by resource name.

inferenceServices.description: Map of InferenceService resources keyed by resource name.

localModelCaches.description: Map of LocalModelCache resources keyed by resource name.

localModelNodeGroups.description: Map of LocalModelNodeGroup resources keyed by resource name.

localModelNodes.description: Map of LocalModelNode resources keyed by resource name.

servingRuntimes.description: Map of ServingRuntime resources keyed by resource name.

trainedModels.description: Map of TrainedModel resources keyed by resource name.

freeFormObject.description: Arbitrary KServe payload passed through by the chart.

enabled.description: Set to false to keep a documented resource stub from rendering.

namespace.description: Namespace for namespaced resources. Ignored for cluster-scoped kinds.
